BuildTarget.description: Default build configuration for build workflows.

InstallPath.description: Absolute path to game install directory containing FFX.exe.

AutoDeploy.description: Automatic deploy behavior after build. Null means first-time interactive prompt.

PreservePaths.description: Paths to preserve during deploy sync. Supports relative paths under InstallPath\fahrenheit and absolute paths.

OpenApiUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for local OCR vision calls.

OpenApiKey.description: API key or environment variable reference in $env:VAR format.

OpenApiModel.description: Model id for local OCR vision passes.

FetchRetryCount.description: Number of additional retries for remote source fetches.

DiscordToken.description: Discord token or environment variable reference in $env:VAR format.
